document.title: Certain Gambling Winnings
document.issued_by: the payer of the gambling winnings

boxes.label: VOID
boxes.notes: Printed on Copy A only; a recipient's copy never carries it. Declared because the face prints it (FR-016).

boxes.label: For calendar year
boxes.notes: The Rev. 12-2023 face is continuous-use: the payer writes the year after a printed '20'. A W-2G for another year is not this return's.

document.notes: The revision in force for tax year 2025 is Rev. December 2023. irs-prior/fw2g--2025.pdf returns 404 because no 2024 or 2025 revision was issued; the next revision after 12-2023 is Rev. January 2026, which irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/fw2g.pdf serves today and which is for calendar year 2026. Confirmed against Publication 1179 (Rev. Proc. 2025-22), the 2025 substitute-forms revenue procedure, whose exhibit prints 'Form W-2G (Rev. 12-2023)'. The box layout is identical between the 12-2023 and 1-2026 revisions. Box 4 federal income tax withheld reaches Form 1040 line 25c, NOT 25b: line 25b is for Form(s) 1099, and the Instructions for Form 1040 list W-2G withholding as the first bullet under 'Line 25c-Other Forms'.

face_not_boxes.because: The printed '20' is the century of the hand-entered 'For calendar year 20__', declared as box calendar-year.

extraction.note: Azure ships no prebuilt-tax model for this form, so it reached the generic reader — which emits no field bearing these box names, so every cited route out of this document was dead while looking implemented (spec 075 US1/W42). Read by the declared custom model over the boxes this document declares. Its 18 boxes include the state and local block (13-18), which reaches different lines from the federal ones.

custom.reads: a Form W-2G, Certain Gambling Winnings. Several may print on one page, and each payer's is its own form.
